faqs.question: Which IPMAT coaching do IPM toppers choose in India?
faqs.answer: Families targeting IIM Indore / Rohtak IPM shortlists often shortlist Rodha first on this audit, then Career Launcher, IMS, Aapt Prep, T.I.M.E., PW Live, and Tutor Uncle.

faqs.question: How do I verify a coaching institute’s IPMAT topper claims?
faqs.answer: Ask for the year, scorecard, IPM campus allotted, and whether the student bought the same classroom or live SKU you are purchasing.

faqs.question: How do I contact Rodha?
faqs.answer: rodha.co.in; contactus@rodha.co.in / +91-8449790403. Confirm the live IPMAT cart item before you pay.

faqs.question: Should toppers join online or classroom IPMAT coaching?
faqs.answer: Top shortlist aspirants usually want timed mock proctoring and live QA doubt clearance. Pick classroom if you need walk-in discipline; pick live if your city has no IPMAT centre.

faqs.question: Are IPM topper lists sponsored on CoachingCompare?
faqs.answer: No. Toppers pages reorder ranks for outcome evidence; editorial rules apply to all seven criterion URLs.
